rows.question: Why can the same 30-day fill cost more at a standard pharmacy than a preferred one on this plan?
rows.answer: On this MAPD pharmacy benefit, preferred retail and standard retail are different cost-share categories for the same days-supply when the network classification on the date of service differs. Preferred retail applies a lower member amount, while standard retail applies a higher member amount. For this plan and period, the matched 30-day metformin 500 mg supply is $8 preferred retail and $27 standard retail under the recorded conditions.
